messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - 5xx spike on outbound S3 egress (us-west-2). Alert triggered by error-rate > 8% for 2m. Affected route: /v1/runtime/ingest -> s3-usw2.
sam.lopez: I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime-oncall. Any customer-facing impact data yet? :mag:
eng-runtime-oncall: joining. saw a spike in 503/504 and some connection timeouts. Noting increased client retries, which is amplifying load.
tina.z: seeing ~12% 5xx per-minute for that route in the last 3m. Hit rate concentrated on multipart upload flows from task-worker group.
jyoti.k: For context: we pushed a config tweak to egress NAT timeouts ~40m ago (reduce idle timeout). Could be related.
leo: quick ask — can someone paste a sample correlation id for a failing request? need to pull kvlogs.
sam.lopez: example correlation_id=cid_20280315_9a4f
eng-runtime-oncall: pulled logs for cid_20280315_9a4f — s3 responded 503 ServiceUnavailable, retry loop in client code shows 3 quick retries then 2s exponential backoff. Attaching log excerpt below:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:21Z worker-17 POST /put?partNumber=3 correlation_id=cid_20280315_9a4f duration=120ms upstream_status=200
2026-03-15T12:03:22Z worker-17 POST /put?partNumber=4 correlation_id=cid_20280315_9a4f duration=15ms upstream_status=503
2026-03-15T12:03:22Z worker-17 RETRY attempt=1 correlation_id=cid_20280315_9a4f
2026-03-15T12:03:23Z worker-17 RETRY attempt=2 correlation_id=cid_20280315_9a4f
2026-03-15T12:03:24Z worker-17 POST /put?partNumber=4 correlation_id=cid_20280315_9a4f duration=5000ms upstream_status=504 timeout
```
ops-bot: Quick mitigation suggestion from playbook: temporarily route outbound S3 traffic via fallback proxy pool (s3-proxy-fallback) or enable local caching for small objects. Would reduce egress pressure. :gear:
jyoti.k: running query to aggregate top error codes by az and by worker group. command I used:
```
logs query "service:runtime AND route:/v1/runtime/ingest AND upstream_status:[500 TO 599]" --from -15m --group-by az,worker_group --limit 50
```
eng-runtime-oncall: results: us-west-2a shows most 503s from worker_group=task-writer, ~68% of errors. egress latency to S3 in that AZ spiked from p50=40ms to p50=900ms.
sam.lopez: Customer impact: GA telemetry shows 3% of active tenants had failed upload attempts in us-west-2 in last 15m. No billing impact yet but user-facing errors on upload flows. Need comms if >5%.
leo: hypothesis 1: upstream S3 transient degradation in us-west-2a. Hypothesis 2: our NAT/egress pool is saturated after config change causing connection resets and 5xx translation. Hypothesis 3: a client fanout pattern created bursts of multipart uploads causing S3 throttling + retries.
tina.z: to test NAT saturation quickly: check SNAT conntrack and egress ENI metrics for task-writer nodes. sam, can you run:
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it snat-checker -- /bin/sh -c "ss -s | grep ESTAB; cat /proc/net/nf_conntrack | wc -l"
```
sam.lopez: running now. conntrack count ~ 192k (threshold 200k), ESTAB connections high (~18k). ENI bandwidth at 80% peak.
eng-runtime-oncall: that points at NAT headroom being low. If conntrack near threshold, new connections may be dropped -> client sees 5xx/timeouts.
ops-bot: mitigation option A: enable additional NAT capacity (spin up additional NAT gateway or increase pool). B: route heavy multipart upload traffic via s3-proxy-fallback which reuses keepalive connections to S3.
jyoti.k: quick smoke — enabling s3-proxy-fallback routing rule for task-writer group now. patch:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/ingress
body: { "match": "worker_group==task-writer", "egress": "s3-proxy-fallback" }
```
sam.lopez: applied routing patch. 30s to take effect across route-cache.
leo: monitoring. initial drop in errors in us-west-2a after ~45s. p50 egress latency down to ~120ms. 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 3.5%.
sam.lopez: continuing to watch. we should still investigate root cause for NAT saturation — reverting timeout change might be bandaid.
tina.z: pulled NAT gateway logs — saw bursts of SYN resets around 12:02:50. looks like many short-lived connections from worker pool.
eng-runtime-oncall: can we gather a timeline: 11:40 deploy (egress timeout change), 11:58 small ramp of multipart job traffic, 12:01 first error spike, 12:03 peak 5xx, 12:06 mitigation routing change, 12:09 error rate falling.
jyoti.k: noted. I'll capture a timeline snippet into the RCA doc.
sam.lopez: did we have any recent client-side change? no code deploys for worker-group since yesterday.
leo: next steps: 1) keep s3-proxy-fallback for the rest of the incident window, 2) add NAT capacity and adjust conntrack threshold, 3) revert the idle timeout change and monitor for reoccurrence, 4) run postmortem with timeline & customer impact.
eng-runtime-oncall: escalation to eng-runtime lead and infra (cc @leo @jyoti.k). attaching correlation_id list for further trace linking:
- cid_20280315_9a4f
- cid_20280315_b7c2
- cid_20280315_c12a

ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-3314 and added timeline/events. Owner: eng-runtime-oncall.
sam.lopez: handoff note for on-call at 12:20 PST: mitigation in place (s3-proxy-fallback), error rate trending down, customer impact limited to ~3% tenants in us-west-2. Follow-up: NAT capacity increase + revert timeout tweak. I'll be available for follow-up until 14:00 PST.
eng-runtime-oncall: thanks — leaving a final checklist in incident ticket and will run a rollup on latency and connection metrics. :white_check_mark:
leo: thanks team. Please capture all log queries and commands in the RCA doc. I'll start the post-incident comms draft if error rate stays low for 1h.
sam.lopez: :wave: handing to next oncall.
